data.title: JPMorgan says crypto regulatory moves partly offset Clarity Act failure, but risks remain
data.summary_raw: JPMorgan said actions by U.S. regulators partly offset the Clarity Act setback, but longer-lasting rules are still needed.

data.title: Blockchain Association pushes for crypto tax clarity as broader bill stalls
data.summary_raw: As progress stalls on a crypto bill, the Blockchain Association is urging Congress to pass legislation to resolve uncertainty around taxes.

data.title: Coinbase Ireland fined $3.6 million over customer fund segregation, oversight failures
data.summary_raw: Coinbase Ireland fined $3.6 million for safeguarding breaches that left customer funds underfunded and mixed with group accounts.

data.title: Uniswap’s aggregator hooks go live on Ethereum, Base and Robinhood Chain
data.summary_raw: Uniswap Labs has launched aggregator hooks, allowing Uniswap v4 to route trades through liquidity held on external platforms.
